The '''Aridinia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]<ref name="Atlas Online" /> and [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Trailing Sectors" /> The system was the origin point of the [[Aridinian folk music]],<ref name="Uprising">''[[Rebel Force: Uprising]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Aridinian folk music]]|system=Aridinia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref> which was infamous for causing [[Human/Legends|Human]] ears to [[Blood/Legends|bleed]] after just a few [[Music/Legends|notes]] and was strictly regulated outside the system as a result.<ref name="Blog">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-an-overview-of-popular-music-and-musicians-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away-part-1|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 1|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Aridinia system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square M-13.<ref name="Atlas Online" />
